decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the original date of approval (15-08-2025).&nbsp;

<div><span style="font-size: 14px;">The windows in the flank elevation of the proposed development shall:</span></div><div><span style="font-size: 14px;"><br></span></div><div><span style="font-size: 14px;">(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass, </span></div><div><span style="font-size: 14px;">(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</span></div>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows / doors, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.&nbsp;

<span style="font-size: 14px;">Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows /doors shall be installed in the flank elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</span>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: <span style="font-size: 14px;">46roxboroughroad/2024/01; 46roxboroughroad/2024/02;</span><div><span style="font-size: 14px;">46roxboroughroad/2024/03; 46roxboroughroad/2024/04;</span></div><div><span style="font-size: 14px;">46roxboroughroad/2024/20; 46roxboroughroad/2024/21;</span></div><div><span style="font-size: 14px;">46roxboroughroad/2024/22 Rev A (04/26); 46roxboroughroad/2024/23 Rev A (04/26);</span></div><div><span style="font-size: 14px;">46roxboroughroad/2024/24 Rev A (04/26); 46roxboroughroad/2024/25; Reasonable Exception</span></div><div><span style="font-size: 14px;">Statement</span></div>
